'''Shane Werner''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Tatooine Regionals]] on 8 July 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Suicide Huntdown]], according to Michael Girard's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d992">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-10-the-brownie-is-no-brownie-tatooine-revd992/ the-brownie-is-no-brownie-tatooine-rev], DeckTech (Michael "Dvader" Girard, 10 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-10-the-brownie-is-no-brownie-tatooine-revd992/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
